note: What's new in Seiza, for visitors: written by hand from the commit history (see home/README.md), newest first.

items.text: Fantasy mode: swords, a katana, a naginata, a light saber, and a bow, with health bars and elemental specials. A blow lands only where a blade really meets someone, and blades parry. Plays on a PC, a phone, or in VR, where you swing for real.
Band mode: play a drum pad, keys, or a guitar for the whole room, or wave a light stick that sways in time with everyone else's. In VR, play with your hands.
Tulay, Seiza's Filipino home: a bahay kubo hall, beach cottages, coconut palms, banig and capiz.
ISCOLab, UP Open University's Immersive Science Communication Open Laboratory, as a lab you can walk through.
SeiOU, a walkable twin of UP Open University's campus with two guides, and Seinag, the same campus with rooftop solar running live on the sky.
Seisugbo, the Meiji × UP arts-based research exhibition, and Seizorai, where Ilaw-san answers questions about the microgrid.
A beach and the sea past the meadow, seasons that blend in, falling leaves, and rain you can hear, with thunder and lightning.
Everything in English and Japanese, including chat translation and the guides.
Portals between the worlds, and a way home to Seiza from each.
Avaturn avatars hold their arms naturally, and designer avatars have real hair, shoes, and clothing details.
In VR: a comfort vignette while you move, smoother rendering, and the admin tools in your wrist menu.
Seizora, a solar, wind, and battery microgrid for a town in Cebu, with live readings and an El Niño scenario.
Seilaya, a safe spaces lab for learning about gender, safety, and respect.
A sky that follows the time and weather in the Philippines, and a room's own time and weather, set by its editors.
Handshakes, high fives, hugs, and a slow dance, which only happen when both people say yes.
VR body tracking and a wrist menu. You can also see your own body in first person.
Avaturn avatars, made ready in your browser, and a built-in avatar designer with expressions and lip sync.
The rooms came alive: a pond you can wade into, light switches, clocks, sliding shoji, a campsite, and a tent to sleep in.
Kneel in seiza long enough and your avatar starts to doze off (you can turn this off for meetings).
Safer uploads and a sturdier room server.
Gestures, with a practice mode, and postures: sitting, and kneeling in seiza.
Boards to write on, screens to present on, an outdoor garden, and a custom sky.
Touch controls for phones, and a limit on how many people a room holds.
The first Seiza: multiplayer rooms you host on your own account, VRM avatars, voice, and editing the world together.
